# KERA News

> KERA News provides comprehensive local, state, and national journalism for North Texas with coverage spanning politics, education, health, arts, and investigative reporting.

KERA News is the news division of KERA, North Texas Public Radio, delivering breaking news and in-depth reporting on issues affecting the Dallas-Fort Worth region and Texas. The organization collaborates with The Texas Newsroom and maintains a team of award-winning journalists covering politics, education, health, arts, and public affairs.

## Key Topics

- North Texas news
- Texas politics
- Breaking news
- Education coverage
- Health & wellness
- Arts & culture
- Investigative journalism
- Dallas-Fort Worth

- [News](https://www.keranews.org/news): KERA News main news section covering breaking news and daily reporting

- [Texas News](https://www.keranews.org/texas-news): Texas state news coverage from KERA News and The Texas Newsroom
- [Someone fatally shot a man in daylight on the Square. Denton's new lawsuit keeps public in the dark about the details months later](https://www.keranews.org/news/2026-03-19/someone-fatally-shot-a-man-in-daylight-on-the-square-dentons-new-lawsuit-keeps-public-in-the-dark-about-the-details-months-later): Investigation into fatal shooting of Jon Ruff in Denton and public records lawsuit

## Politics & Elections

- [Election 2026](https://www.keranews.org/election-2026): Comprehensive Election 2026 coverage including Texas primary and senate race

- [How the Texas primaries broke spending records](https://www.keranews.org/news/2026-03-19/how-the-texas-primaries-broke-spending-records): Analysis of record-breaking campaign spending in 2026 Texas Senate primary

- [Health & Wellness](https://www.keranews.org/health-wellness): KERA's health and wellness coverage including Vital Signs and Breakthroughs series
